chung.san_pham_hinh: Men's stretch pants that look like smooth dress trousers cut from denim — NOT classic five-pocket jeans. High rise, straight leg, relaxed but not baggy. Flat front; two slanted (slash) front pockets; NO coin pocket, NO rivets, NO contrast or gold stitching (stitching is tonal, same color as the fabric); zip fly with a single button; belt loops; two back pockets with button-through closure. Fabric: smooth, uniform, solid-color stretch denim twill with a soft sheen — NO fading, NO whiskering, NO distressing, NO wash marks. Main color Light Blue (vivid cobalt/royal blue).
